claim: *One Measurement, Different Enforcement Decisions.* The same measured quantity may be observed without enforcement, used to adapt behavior, trigger graceful degradation, or control admission. The appropriate response follows from the obligation attached to the measurement.
topology: One model through one policy fans out to alternative responses; adaptation has a degradation child.
required_terms: Response follows the obligation attached to the quantity.
bw_encoding: White ordinary nodes and groups; labels and boundaries carry roles without decorative tones.
redesign: Native nodes and routed edges preserve the original semantic structure, with print-sized labels and fewer decorative frames. Grayscale refinement: Observe remains white, adaptation light gray, admission gate dark gray: three policy modes restored. Fidelity pass: Moved dormant-unless-configured caveat out of gate node into an external annotation, as in original.
alt:
A single cost and usage model is read through a policy attached to the value. That policy
    selects one response. Observe reports evidence without consequence. Adapt changes load, throttling and
    then producing soft completion rather than outright rejection. Gate blocks admission and is dormant
    unless configured. The appropriate response follows from the obligation attached to the measurement, not
    from a maturity sequence.

qa.compiler: LuaLaTeX TeX Live 2025; no shell escape; root mage-figures.sty
qa.inspection: Original source raster and native final PDF raster compared for icons, links, grouping, external annotations and font hierarchy; native 9–12pt prose; geometry sensor has zero findings.

style_review.shape: Ordinary boxes use modest rounded corners; semantic document, state, decision, marker and quantitative shapes retain their roles.
style_review.visual_review: Observe/adapt/gate remain named alternatives; dormant caveat stays outside gate.
